lines.text: Many learners say: Ali plays soccer now.
Better: Ali is playing soccer now.
Is singing! She is singing now.

native.tip: نقول «يلعب الآن» بصيغة واحدة، أما مع now فنقول is playing: “Ali is playing soccer now.” وليس “Ali plays soccer now.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “Ali plays soccer now.” 😅 نقول «يلعب الآن» بصيغة واحدة، أما مع now فنقول is playing، فالجملة الصحيحة “Ali is playing soccer now.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “is playing” — نقول «يلعب الآن» بصيغة واحدة، أما مع now فنقول is playing. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic one form says «يلعب الآن», but with now we say is playing: “Ali is playing soccer now.” not “Ali plays soccer now.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Ali plays soccer now.” 😅 In Arabic one form says «يلعب الآن», but with now we say is playing, so the right sentence is “Ali is playing soccer now.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
